entries.name: Node 22 native TypeScript execution
entries.evidence: node 22.22.2 ran a .ts module and node --test executed .ts tests with no dependencies installed
entries.notes: This is why the kernel needs no build step and no npm install to run.

entries.name: Neterverse shared-state kernel
entries.evidence: 43 tests pass under node --test; covers lane firewall, approval boundary, event log, leases, schema validation
entries.notes: Local to the repository. Nothing is deployed.

entries.name: Six source-of-truth connectors reachable
entries.evidence: One read-only call each to GitHub, Drive, ClickUp, Notion, Calendar, Gmail

entries.name: Zapier, Composio, IFTTT tool surfaces
entries.evidence: Tool names appeared in the runtime listing. No call was made, so no workflow, connection or write path is verified.
entries.notes: Section 15 requires one owning automation engine per production trigger and write path. That ownership is not yet assigned, so no engine may be described as owning anything.

entries.name: Cloudflare, Wix, Shopify, Floot tool surfaces
entries.evidence: Listed in the runtime. Not exercised.
entries.notes: Any commerce action here is R3 or R4 and stops at the human gate.

entries.name: MCP connector session stability
entries.evidence: Connector servers disconnected and reconnected repeatedly during this session; roughly 640 tool schemas dropped and returned mid-task.
entries.notes: Any automation that assumes a connector stays attached for the length of a run needs a retry path. Recorded because a flapping connector reads as a permanent failure to code that does not expect it.
